name: desktop
description: AI网文诊断台 桌面外壳（Electron）：拉起本地 API + Next 服务并加载到窗口

scripts.pack: pnpm run assemble && pnpm run build && pnpm -F @app/electron run pack
scripts.release: pnpm run assemble && pnpm run build && pnpm -F @app/electron run package
scripts.format: oxfmt --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml apps/electron/script apps/electron/src apps/electron/tsconfig.json apps/electron/tsdown.config.ts packages/preload/package.json packages/preload/src packages/preload/tsconfig.json packages/preload/tsdown.config.ts
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml apps/electron/script apps/electron/src apps/electron/tsconfig.json apps/electron/tsdown.config.ts packages/preload/package.json packages/preload/src packages/preload/tsconfig.json packages/preload/tsdown.config.ts
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run build
